big: A client wants defence exposure. She may already have it. HAL and BEL are common holdings in large-cap and flexi-cap funds. Check what she owns before adding more.

lines: How can clients get defence exposure?

Defence index funds or ETFs, such as one tracking the Nifty India Defence index, thematic defence or manufacturing funds, or diversified funds. Check overlap before adding a defence fund to a large-cap portfolio. Thematic funds need a 3 to 5 year view, entered by SIP or STP.
